The company may consider targets across enterprise software, industrials, [...] industrials, healthcare, financial services, energy, mobility, logistics and cybersecurity, without being limited to a particular AI segment. Target criteria include differentiated technology, scalable business models, defensible market positions, experienced management, meaningful intellectual property, established revenue and opportunities for growth [...] and liquidate. Its investment proposition therefore depends on management’s ability to source and execute an attractive AI-related acquisition, with public investors retaining redemption or tender rights around the transaction.

items.snippet: Organizations that answer these questions early can avoid accounting surprises, ...
items.raw_snippet:
Organizations that answer these questions early can avoid accounting surprises, support defensible capitalization positions, and provide greater transparency into the return on their AI investments.

## With AI, the tool matters. The intent matters more

Many organizations begin by focusing on the technology itself. Is it generative AI? Agentic AI? A large language model? A custom machine learning solution?

From an accounting perspective, those distinctions are often secondary. [...] These issues can affect the applicable software-cost model as well as valuation, impairment, commercialization strategy, and financial reporting. For hosted AI offerings, the underlying development costs may be subject to ASC 350-40, including when the software is used to provide a SaaS offering to customers. When evaluating the applicable software-cost model, organizations should consider whether the customer receives a software license or instead receives access only to the hosted [...] The answer is less about the artificial intelligence itself and more about how the software will be used. Despite the rapid evolution of technology, AI development and implementation generally fall within existing accounting frameworks. The challenge for CFOs and controllers is determining which framework applies, identifying when capitalization begins, understanding the implications of licensing models, and helping to ensure appropriate subsequent measurement and disclosure.

items.title: Washoe County推出Search Assistant提升数字信息获取
items.snippet: [该县将推出Search Assistant，帮助居民更便捷地获取县府服务与资源信息。]
items.raw_snippet:
Finding information about Washoe County services and resources will be a lot easier with the launch of the Washoe County Search Assistant, a conversational, artificial intelligence-powered tool now available on washoecounty.gov. The tool will launch on Tuesday, Nov. 17. [...] Using the Washoe County Search Assistant is easy!  

 Visitors at washoecounty.gov can access the Washoe County Search Assistant by clicking the “Search Assistant” button in the bottom-right corner of any page on washoecounty.gov.

 Once opened, select “Start Chat” to begin, then enter and send your question in the message field.

 The Search Assistant will use artificial intelligence to understand your request, find relevant information and generate a response. [...] 6. Can I trust the information provided by the Washoe County Search Assistant?

Yes, however the Washoe County Search Assistant does use artificial intelligence to generate responses, which may occasionally contain inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated information. We encourage you to verify important information using the provided references or by contacting 311 or the appropriate Washoe County department.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is not just for technology experts. It is quickly becoming an essential leadership tool for professionals across industries.

Dyersburg State Community College (DSCC) Workforce Development will host “The AI-Enabled Leader: Practical Strategies to Increase Productivity, Improve Decision-Making, and Lead More Effectively” workshop on Wednesday, December 9, at the DSCC main campus in Dyersburg. [...] His distinguished career includes 10 years with Panasonic Corporation and 15 years as vice president of product management and marketing at Teltronics. For the past decade, Doyle has served as an executive coach and leadership development consultant, helping organizations and leaders achieve lasting success. [...] Designed specifically for busy professionals, The AI-Enabled Leader will show participants how to leverage AI to boost productivity, sharpen strategic thinking, and streamline everyday leadership tasks. Participants will learn practical strategies they can put to work immediately and leave the workshop with an action plan for incorporating AI into their daily responsibilities.
